cues: And the pea was a lucky choice.
It pollinates itself, because the keel petals wrap the stamens and stigma, so pure lines are easy to keep.
Yet it can be crossed by hand after removing the anthers.
It grows fast, gives many seeds, and shows seven clear pairs of characters.
